description: This file contains test functions for the litellm Python library, specifically testing integration with the Ollama local server, including embeddings, streaming, function calling, custom prompts, and error handling.

methods.name: test_ollama_aembeddings
methods.description: Async test for generating embeddings with the Ollama model using litellm.

methods.name: test_ollama_embeddings
methods.description: Synchronous test for generating embeddings with the Ollama model.

methods.name: test_ollama_streaming
methods.description: Test for streaming completions from the Ollama model with specific function definitions.

methods.name: async_test_ollama_streaming
methods.description: Async version of streaming test for Ollama completions.

methods.name: test_completion_ollama
methods.description: Test for standard completion request to Ollama model.

methods.name: test_completion_ollama_function_calling
methods.description: Test for completion with function calling feature.

methods.name: async_test_completion_ollama_function_calling
methods.description: Async version of function calling completion test.

methods.name: test_completion_ollama_with_api_base
methods.description: Test for completion request specifying a custom API base URL.

methods.name: test_completion_ollama_custom_prompt_template
methods.description: Test for registering and using a custom prompt template.

methods.name: test_completion_expect_error
methods.description: Test for handling errors when requesting an invalid model.

methods.name: test_ollama_llava
methods.description: Test for multimedia input (including images) with the Ollama model.

methods.description: Utility function to prepare chat messages for testing.

methods.description: Async helper to send a chat message with streaming enabled.
